title: seo: run propose_seo_titles.py --check on PRs; it is only caught by main_health, and posts keep landing over the title budget
problem: propose_seo_titles.py --check fails when a post's title is over budget and has no seo_title. No workflow under .github/workflows runs it (grep, 2026-11-08), so it is only found by platform/ci/main_health.py. The same day main_health found 2 such posts (photo tilt meter) and then 5 more (roof uplift, Sydney Olympics, Korea/India check digits, Japan arrivals, ABN/IRD/PIB). Earlier broken-main incidents: docs/history/pages-build-perf-2026-11-06-broken-main-seo-title.md. The workflow edit is in .github/, held for the owner by CODEOWNERS.

change: Add a step running 'python3 platform/pages/propose_seo_titles.py --check' (under a second) to the PR docs/posts check job, or to an existing always-run lint job.
